This is a source-built preview provider qualification, independent of the
published Router corpus. The exact upstream commit and tree are pinned in
`source.json`. Its package manifest still says `5.4.0`; that version does not
identify the published npm archive. The source recipe, build inputs, actual
archive bytes, tar member identities, semantic exports, and same-run transfer
receipt establish the provider identity instead.

The original upstream frozen installation and tsdown build run in Actions.
No provider export is added or patched. The real built experimental entry must
export `_RoutePropsForFilePath` and must not be assumed to export `useRoute`.
The consumer invokes its actual route scanner and retains the full generated
declaration. Executable scanner captures are retained outside authored roots.

The first campaign observes manually explicit real helper arguments and the
component generic on `definePage`. It captures valid, invalid, repaired,
LF/CRLF, and opt-in-disabled controls with the reference, the released control,
and the receipted source checker. Raw bytes and complete reports are retained
before comparisons. This discovery state intentionally cannot confer
qualification credit. Independent complete oracles must be frozen and admitted
before strict acceptance; automatic page-props projection is separate work.
